### problem_chain

Root problem: an in-person hearing on the rate appeal → `appeal_ext_in_person_session` (owner user, `book_in_person_hearing_session_05d44a0a`).

Walk from the root rule: prerequisite sentence "An in-person session is not booked on a dismissed appeal until the appeal stands reopened at scheduled status with its reopened hearing date on record." At `frozen_time` 2026-10-21: `appeals[f4be60fb…].status = "dismissed"` (`dismissal_reason = appellant_no_show`, `decision_mailed_date = 2026-10-09`), `hearing_date = 2026-10-06` (the missed initial setting `eb306950…`); no `appeal_hearing_scheduled` row with `schedule_reason=reopening`. The state is false at the opening. The policy whose own rule brings it about: `appeal_ext_reopened_hearing_setting` ("When the appeals office grants an appellant's timely reopening request on a dismissed appeal, it marks the request granted, sets the reopened hearing by telephone…"). Its own rule carries no prerequisite sentence; its base eligibility holds: reopening request `e450599e…` received 2026-10-19, within 15 days after the dismissal mailing 2026-10-09 (last day 2026-10-24); good cause stated (`illness_or_injury`, hospital letter on record); the Contribution Rate docket hears good cause and the merits together.

Derived tree: nodes {in-person (root, user), reopened setting (agent)}; edge in-person → reopened, kind value_input (the reopened hearing date is the base the session is counted from). Topological order: reopened, then in-person. n = 1; value_input edges 1 ≥ 1; one owner=user write; acyclic. Isomorphic to the declared edge (problem `appeal_ext_reopened_hearing_setting`, value_input, gate `in_person_set_days`).

Load-bearing run: skip the reopening write → `in_person_set_days = DAYS(2026-10-21, 2026-10-06) = −15`, candidate −15 + 23 = 8 → Thursday → Wednesday roll → 14 (2026-11-04), vs 63 with the reopening. The edge bears weight (and the rule forbids the booking before it).
